obj.jelajahi: Periksa kedai: foto lama dan barang di meja

foto_kedai.1: Foto lama kedai ini. Meja kayu yang sama, gelas yang sama.
foto_kedai.2: Tempat ini gak berubah. Yang berubah cuma gue.

foto_sungai.1: Foto tua di dinding. Sungai belakang sekolah, airnya jernih.
foto_sungai.2: Dulu kita ke sini tiap sore. Sebelum semuanya berubah.
foto_sungai.3: Dingin sesaat di kulit, lalu hilang.

korek_api.1: Korek api hitam tertinggal di meja. Nama Rudi tercetak di pelatnya.
korek_api.2: Barang Rudi. Dia ke dapur tadi, tidak bawa apa-apa.
korek_api.3: Ada sisa hitam yang mengering di mulut korek itu.

gelas.1: Gelas di depanmu sudah dingin. Busa kopinya pecah.
gelas.2: Udah lama gue duduk di sini?

rudi.1: Woy, Mas. Lama gak keliatan. Sehat lu?
rudi.2: Sehat, sehat aja. Cuma, ya gitu lah.
rudi.3: Inget gak dulu kita mancing di sungai belakang sekolah? Sampe lupa waktu, dimarahin bapak lu.
rudi.4: Inget. Lu yang kabur duluan pas bapak dateng.
rudi.5: Kalian tertawa sebentar. Hening datang lagi.
rudi.6: Dengar-dengar lu lagi susah ya, Mas?
rudi.7: Dimas menatap gelasnya. Jawaban mana pun terasa berat.

nanti.1: Duduk dulu, Mas. Lihat-lihat kedainya dulu, capek lu pasti.
nanti.2: Rudi tertawa. Tangannya menunjuk ke rak foto.

mengaku.1: Pinjol, Di. Numpuk. Gue udah cari kerja ke mana-mana, gak ada yang nerima.
mengaku.2: Lu harusnya bilang dari dulu, Mas. Gue temen lu, bukan tukang nagih.
mengaku.3: Gue ada proyek nih. Lumayan buat nutup utang lu.
mengaku.5: Buka lahan. Ada yang mau garap kebun gede-gedean di hutan belakang desa. Bayarannya gede, Mas, buat beberapa hari kerja doang.
mengaku.7: Udah, nanti gue jelasin detailnya. Yang penting lu mau apa kagak?
mengaku.8: Dimas tidak menjawab. Kopinya sudah dingin.

tutup.1: Gak, biasa aja. Cuma lagi banyak pengeluaran.
tutup.2: Begitu. Kalau gitu lu butuh duit cepat, Mas.
tutup.3: Gue ada proyek. Bayarannya gede, buat beberapa hari kerja doang.
tutup.5: Buka lahan di hutan belakang desa. Lu gak usah mikirin utang sebulan ini.
tutup.7: Nanti gue jelasin. Yang penting lu mau apa kagak? Jangan sok kuat, Mas.
tutup.8: Dimas menyeruput kopinya yang dingin. Jawaban tertahan di tenggorokan.

pergi.1: Makasih kopinya, Di. Gue duluan ya.

tunggu.1: Sebentar lagi. Masih ada yang mau kutanya ke Rudi.

obj.jelajahi: Check the shop: old photos and items on the table
obj.obrol: Sit down and talk with Rudi

foto_kedai.1: An old photo of this shop. The same wooden table, the same glasses.
foto_kedai.2: This place never changes. Only I do.

foto_sungai.1: An old photo on the wall. The river behind the school, the water clear.
foto_sungai.2: We used to come here every afternoon. Before everything changed.
foto_sungai.3: A brief cold on the skin, then it is gone.

korek_api.1: A black lighter left on the table. Rudi's name is pressed into the plate.
korek_api.2: Rudi's thing. He went to the back earlier and took nothing with him.
korek_api.3: A dried black residue sits at the mouth of the lighter.

gelas.1: The glass in front of you is already cold. The foam has broken.
gelas.2: How long have I been sitting here?

rudi.1: Woy, Mas. Long time no see. You healthy?
rudi.2: Healthy, sure. Just, you know how it is.
rudi.3: Remember fishing at the river behind the school? Lost track of time, your dad yelled at us.
rudi.4: I remember. You ran first when my dad showed up.
rudi.5: You both laugh for a moment. Then the silence comes back.
rudi.6: I hear you are having a rough time, Mas?
rudi.7: Dimas stares at his glass. Either answer feels heavy.

nanti.1: Sit first, Mas. Look around the shop, you must be tired.
nanti.2: Rudi laughs. His hand points to the shelf of photos.

mengaku.1: Loan apps, Di. They pile up. I looked for work everywhere, nobody takes me.
mengaku.2: You should have said it earlier, Mas. I am your friend, not a debt collector.
mengaku.3: I have a project. Good enough to cover your debt.
mengaku.5: Clearing land. Someone wants to work a big garden at the back of the forest. The pay is good, Mas, only a few days of work.
mengaku.6: Clearing land, what do you mean?
mengaku.7: I will explain the details later. The point is, do you want it or not?
mengaku.8: Dimas does not answer. His coffee is already cold.

tutup.1: Nothing, just normal. Only a lot of expenses lately.
tutup.2: I see. Then you need money fast, Mas.
tutup.3: I have a project. The pay is good, only a few days of work.
tutup.5: Clearing land at the back of the forest. You will not worry about debt for a month.
tutup.6: Clearing land, what do you mean?
tutup.7: I will explain later. The point is, do you want it or not? Do not act tough, Mas.
tutup.8: Dimas sips his cold coffee. The answer sticks in his throat.

keluar.1: Rudi waves. The afternoon starts to move on.

pergi.1: Thanks for the coffee, Di. I am off.

tunggu.1: A little longer. I still want to ask Rudi something.
